summary: Scope finite-work memory pressure to its lanes and protect host free memory

schema.detail: No client schema, generated code or API shape changes.

rules.detail: Linux finite-work admission combines aggregate lane memory PSI, root memory full PSI qualified while the last positive vmstat allocstall delta is no older than the configured PSI window (10, 60 or 300 seconds inclusive), and an independent MemAvailable floor. Windowed evidence protects against bursty reclaim and long stalls. Background kswapd scans and memcg direct scans do not qualify root pressure. Initial counters and resets deliberately yield lane-only readings. An absent lane slice is quiet; existing lane cgroups with missing, unreadable or malformed PSI remain unknown. Missing, malformed, duplicate, truncated or stale required observations close admission. IO PSI remains host-wide.

compatibility.detail: Existing psiBrake policies remain valid. Optional memoryAvailableFloorBytes defaults to the absolute value 2147483648 bytes (2 GiB) and applies independently of configured PSI rules. Zero disables the floor; a positive floor at or above MemTotal is rejected at reader construction, with a per-sample backstop.

downtime.detail: The new signal takes effect after daemon restart.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback requires no data migration.
